mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in FEDFUNDS above 4% in a month signals aggressive Fed easing, lowering real rates and boosting equity present value, driving positive S&P 500 20-day returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4% in a single month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05) during such FEDFUNDS spikes.

mechanism_narrative: Rising PAYEMS (labor market tightness) while UNRATE falls indicates a shift from labor scarcity to abundance, reducing wage growth and compressing equity valuations, producing negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases while UNRATE decreases in the same month
regime_hint: Labor market transition from tight to loose
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive in >70% of such labor transition events.

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly rise in HOUST (residential construction) and a decline in INDPRO (industrial production) suggest structural demand shift toward consumer goods, boosting equity valuations and driving positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: HOUST up while INDPRO down for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: 60-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during such demand shifts.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in INDPRO below 100 (monthly) combined with elevated GDPC1 (GDP) suggests supply-side contraction, lowering growth expectations and producing negative 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are positive in >50% of such contraction events.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained decline in CPIAUCSL (inflation) below 2% for 3 months indicates disinflation, lowering real rates and supporting equity valuations, yielding positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL falls below 2% for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not positive (p > 0.05) during sustained CPIAUCSL declines.

mechanism_narrative: UNRATE falls below 4% while PAYEMS remains flat, signaling labor market softening without tightness, reducing wage growth and depressing equity valuations, resulting in negative 60-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS does not increase in the same quarter
failure_condition: 60-day returns are not negative (p > 0.05) in such labor regimes.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden spike in RSAFS (federal reserve balance sheet) followed by a drop in HOUST suggests excess liquidity chasing weak demand, compressing valuations and producing negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases by >10% in a month while HOUST falls
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during such events.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive monthly declines in both INDPRO and GDPC1 suggest persistent supply-side weakness, lowering growth prospects and generating negative 5-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 down while INDPRO down in the same month (2 consecutive months)
failure_condition: 5-day returns are positive in >50% of such contraction events.
